groups.title: Mothership Siege
entries: New mode: Mothership Siege. The IRON VANGUARD, a 1.5 km carrier bristling with sixteen flak and heavy cannon turrets, hangs off Saturn under a shield bubble. AEGIS flies escort, KRONOS brings it down. Pick a side from the new SIEGE tile on the home screen, or switch the mode in a multiplayer lobby.

Break the carrier in three stages: knock out the four shield generators, hammer the hull armour as breaches blow open and fires spread, then destroy the reactor once its shutters tear away. Attackers share a pool of reinforcements that grows each time a stage falls; defenders win if the clock runs out or the attack runs dry.
Watch it go: when the reactor fails, explosions race along the hull and the IRON VANGUARD breaks apart into burning sections. If the defenders hold, it lights its engines and jumps to warp.

Turrets track and lead you, so jink. Your HUD marks every generator, turret and the reactor, the radar shows the carrier's outline, and AI pilots on both sides fly strafing runs, escorts and guard patrols.

groups.title: New ship: Silverwing
entries: New starfighter: the Silverwing, a swept-wing strike fighter with twin-barrel cannons on each wingtip. Its guns swivel to track your target, kick back with every shot and glow when they overheat, and its three engines blaze with thrust.

PC: proper fullscreen. The game now starts in borderless fullscreen; press F11 or Alt+Enter to switch any time, or pick Windowed, Fullscreen or Exclusive in Settings › Graphics. Your choice is remembered.

Mouse flying feels like a joystick now: the aim reticle stays where you push it and your ship keeps turning toward it, so you no longer have to keep dragging the mouse. Pull it back to the centre to fly straight, or tap X / middle mouse to snap it home. Deadzone and an optional auto-centre are in Settings › Controls.

groups.title: Star Battles is live
entries: 10 v 10 Conquest around Saturn: capture three relay stations or out-gun the enemy fleet, with AI wingmen filling every empty seat.
Three starfighters with gimbal-mounted cannons, lasers, railguns and lock-on missiles, plus animated engines with boost trails.
Destructible asteroid field: shoot big rocks and they split into hot, tumbling fragments.
Online multiplayer over Wi-Fi or the internet, with a public battle list, plus pilot accounts and cloud saves.
Console-style home screen, full touch, gamepad and keyboard controls, and an in-game updater that shows what's new.
